description: Saïd Business School, University of Oxford. # Oxford Artificial Intelligence Programme. * **Curriculum:** Build an in-depth understanding of AI and how to leverage technologies. Installment plan for the Oxford Artificial Intelligence Programme. Oxford Artificial Intelligence Programme banner. The Oxford AI Programme was a real eye-opener. The content was fascinating, breaking down complex AI concepts in a way that just made sense, covering everything from AI's history to its business and ethical implications. The Oxford Artificial Intelligence Programme is a six-week online programme designed to equip participants with an in-depth understanding of AI's history, functionality, capabilities, and ethical considerations. Throughout the programme, participants will receive guidance from esteemed faculty members from the University of Oxford, enabling them to develop an informed opinion on the applications of AI. Is this Oxford AI programme for you? The design of this online programme is guided by Oxford Saïd faculty, as well as industry experts, who will share their experience and in-depth subject knowledge with you throughout the programme.

This repository contains the lecture slides and course description for the Deep Natural Language Processing course offered in Hilary Term 2017 at the University of Oxford. These topics are organised into three high level themes forming a progression from understanding the use of neural networks for sequential language modelling, to understanding their use as conditional language models for transduction tasks, and finally to approaches employing these techniques in combination with other mechanisms for advanced applications.

description: # A Free Oxford Course on Deep Learning: Cutting Edge Lessons in Artificial Intelligence. Nan­do de Fre­itas is a “machine learn­ing pro­fes­sor at Oxford Uni­ver­si­ty, a lead research sci­en­tist at Google Deep­Mind, and a Fel­low of the Cana­di­an Insti­tute For Advanced Research (CIFAR) in theNeur­al Com­pu­ta­tion and Adap­tive Per­cep­tion pro­gram.”. Above, you can watch him teach an Oxford course on Deep Learn­ing, a hot sub­field of machine learn­ing and arti­fi­cial intel­li­gence which cre­ates neur­al networks–essentially com­plex algo­rithms mod­eled loose­ly after the human brain–that can rec­og­nize pat­terns and learn to per­form tasks.
